sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the test tools and the estimator and the logged decision type.
sections.why: Gives the tests the estimator to check.

sections.name: rng
sections.title: Seeded random generator
sections.what: Creates a repeatable random number source for the synthetic data.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the synthetic results stable from run to run.
sections.watch_out: This is a separate copy of the generator used in the calibration tests. Keep them in step if one changes.

sections.name: simulate
sections.title: Synthetic decision generator
sections.what: Builds logged decisions where the true reward for each action is known. The helper models and the propensity can each be made right or wrong.
sections.why: Lets the test compare the estimator with a value it can know in advance.
sections.watch_out: The flags that choose right or wrong models decide which failure case is being tested.

sections.name: doubly robust estimate (dr)
sections.title: Estimator accuracy and bad input
sections.what: Checks that the estimate is close to 0.5 for each action when at least one helper model is right. Checks that empty logs and a propensity of 1 throw errors.
sections.why: Likely reason: the estimator is meant to tolerate one wrong model, and bad inputs would give misleading numbers.
sections.watch_out: The propensity of 1 check is a guard. Removing it would let degenerate data produce wrong answers silently.

summary: Checks the doubly robust estimator on synthetic logged decisions, showing it stays accurate when either of its two helper models is right.
purpose: Protects the core estimator used by the offline death-over check.
why: Likely reason: the estimator is only trustworthy if it is proven on data where the true answer is known.
how: Generates synthetic decisions where the true value is 0.5 for each action. Runs the estimator with each combination of right and wrong models. Checks that empty input and a propensity of 1 throw errors.
inputs: Synthetic data built inside the test, with a fixed seed.
risks: The tolerance is one decimal place, and 40,000 rows make the run slow. The tests cover only one synthetic setup.
debug: If the estimate drifts, check how the propensity and the outcome model values are used in the estimator.
